# Soho Nails Spa

> Nails, nail art & pedicures based in Bloomington, Indiana. Gel manicures, acrylic and dip sets, chrome and cat-eye finishes, spa pedicures and custom nail art on S Pete Ellis Dr in Bloomington. Walk in or call ahead, and bring your inspiration picture.

- Phone: (812) 955-1628
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Bedford, Martinsville, Spencer
- Google rating: 4.3 from 127 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/indiana/soho-nails-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/indiana/soho-nails-spa/book.html

## Services
- Gel manicures: High-gloss gel on natural nails, cured under LED for up to two weeks of shine.
- Acrylic, dip & fills: Full sets and fill-ins in natural, French, ombre or dip powder, shaped the way you like.
- Custom nail art: Florals, characters, tortoise, French twists: bring the picture and we'll paint it by hand.
- Chrome, cat-eye & glitter: Chrome jelly, magnetic cat-eye and holographic glitter that catches every light.
- Spa pedicures: Classic, hot stone or hot paraffin wax pedicures in our pedicure chairs, with reflexology add-ons.
- Classic care & kids: Classic, hot stone and paraffin manicures, plus little-hands nail care for ages 10 and under.

## About
Soho Nails Spa sits in Suite 4 of the strip center at 223 S Pete Ellis Dr, on Bloomington's east side. Walk in or call ahead for anything from a quick gel change to a full acrylic set with hand-painted art. Inside you'll find a long wall of polishes, dips and acrylic colors, a row of pedicure chairs, and white tables with the pink padded arm rests you'll spot in our photos. Clients tell us they notice how clean the salon, chairs and tools are kept. Regulars ask for their tech by name. Clients say Nikki goes above and beyond to make a set just as good as the picture, or better, that TJ keeps nervous first-timers relaxed with a simple "we got you," and that Lily's nails come out perfect every time.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. For a full set, nail art or a Saturday visit, call (812) 955-1628 first so we can have a chair ready.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9:30 am to 7 pm, Saturday 9:30 am to 6 pm, closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead.
- Q: How much is a manicure or pedicure?
  A: From our price board: classic manicure $20, gel manicure $30, classic pedicure $30 and gel spa pedicure $40. The full list is on our services page. Prices can change, so call to confirm.
- Q: Can I bring an inspiration photo?
  A: Please do. Save it on your phone and show your tech before we start. Custom nail art is our favorite thing to do.
- Q: Do you do kids' nails?
  A: Yes. Kids 10 and under can get a manicure, a spa pedicure or a polish change, with a little nail art or French on top.
- Q: Do you sell gift cards?
  A: Yes. Soho Nails Spa gift cards are available on Giftly, or ask us next time you're in.
